create_fast_stop_training_hook: create a FastStopTrainingHook instance to stop training after a specified number of iterations or epochs
configure_hook_by_epoch: configure the FastStopTrainingHook to stop training based on epoch count instead of iterations
enable_checkpoint_saving: enable checkpoint saving in FastStopTrainingHook by setting save_ckpt to True for epoch-based training
set_stop_threshold: set the stop_iter_or_epoch parameter to control when FastStopTrainingHook triggers a quick exit
register_hook_with_mmengine: register the FastStopTrainingHook with the HOOKS registry for use in mmdet training runners
